description: Write a file on one of your Prized boxes, replacing it whole if it exists; missing parent directories are created. Content is UTF-8 text, or base64 with encoding "base64"; up to 1 MiB (for bigger files, your person can use `prized cp`). Paths are relative to your home on the box, ~/..., or absolute. It does not wake a paused box: resume_box first, or use run_on_box.

box.description: The box: its name (such as mango) or its id, from list_boxes.

content.description: The file content: text, or base64 when encoding is "base64".

path.description: Where to write, such as app/config.json (under your home on the box) or /tmp/notes.txt.

name: write_box_file
title: Write a file on a box
